newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway to keep 1997 CPI forecast unchanged - source.
newsitem.headline: Norway to keep 1997 CPI forecast unchanged - source.

text.p: Norway will keep its forecast for 1997 consumer prices unchanged at 2.5 percent when the government presents its revised budget for the year on Tuesday, a source at the Finance Ministry said.
Finance Minister Jens Stoltenberg said last week the government would revise upwards its estimate for Gross Domestic Product growth, investment and employment.
The government is due to present the revised budget for 1997 at 0945 GMT.
